clips.title: The story
paras: Therysil is a dryad dwelling at the Shrine of Aessina in central Ashenvale. Deeply devoted to the preservation of nature, she waits anxiously for word of her sister, Therylune, who fell into the hands of sinister cultists.

Therysil makes her home near the tranquil waters of the Shrine of Aessina, a sacred glade within the ancient woods of Ashenvale. Like all dryads, the daughters of Cenarius, she is bound to the defense of the wild and the spirits dwelling within it. Yet her focus has been torn from quiet stewardship to gnawing worry. Her sister, Therylune, was captured nearby by the deranged Twilight's Hammer cult, leaving Therysil desperate for any wandering ally willing to aid in her sister's rescue.
